title: A restricted physical-dynamics claim is recorded without inventing its theorem
statement: Visible source reports that a 3D encoded qubit retains protection under weak generic LOCAL quantum interactions with a SPIN environment using exact physical dynamics rather than an idealized noise generator. This is a producer-reported restricted construction, not an unrestricted bath/noise theorem. Precise locality/weakness/norm, thermal-state definition, code family/geometry conditions, time/error/size quantifiers and actual reviewed versions are unavailable. Source says separate internal reviews passed and TEN packaged checks reran successfully, but proof/review receipts/subjects/hashes/code/results were not received. Archive button/filename is not confirmed acquisition. Preserve reported success as reported; zero accepted review overlays and no Capital scientific audit/replay. Do not retroactively grant exact-dynamics/3D hardware to earlier six-qubit GKSL/qudit/allocator results.
